title: Online MCA with Quantum Computing Elective | DSU Online
description: Bridge the gap between classical and quantum. Explore DSU's Online MCA elective in Quantum Computing, designed for IT professionals eyeing 2026 tech trends.

blocks.x: Qubits & Quantum States | Quantum Gates & Circuits | Superposition | Entanglement | Shor's Algorithm | Grover's Algorithm | Foundations of High-Performance Quantum Computing

The elective introduces qubits, quantum gates, superposition, entanglement, and major quantum algorithms like Shor's and Grover's. Concepts are simplified to help learners understand the future of high-performance computing..
Qubits are the basic units of quantum information that can exist in multiple states simultaneously. This module explains how quantum states are represented and manipulated.
Quantum gates perform operations on qubits to build circuits. This module covers how these gates enable complex quantum computations.
Superposition allows a qubit to exist in multiple states at the same time, increasing computational possibilities in quantum systems.
Entanglement links qubits so that the state of one instantly affects the other, enabling powerful quantum communication and processing.
Shor's algorithm efficiently factors large numbers and challenges classical encryption. This module explains how it works.
Grover's algorithm accelerates search operations in unstructured datasets, dramatically reducing search time.
This module introduces how quantum computers achieve superior performance for computationally intensive tasks.
